scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently applied for an FHA home purchase loan for $205,000, with a 30-year term. I haven’t heard back yet—can you tell me what the status or outcome of my application is?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your question. Your FHA home purchase loan application for $205,000 with a 30-year term has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you have any other questions about your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user: That’s great news—thank you for letting me know! Could you please tell me what my assigned interest rate is, and let me know if there are any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your assigned interest rate is 6.750%. This loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and it does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the information! Can you also tell me what the total costs of the loan are, and whether my loan has been sold or transferred to another institution?
dialogue.agent: Your total loan costs are $12,821.84. After origination, your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for your help and the clear information. I appreciate the straightforward answers about the approval, rate, costs, and purchaser.

<Satisfied> 

I’m satisfied with the interaction because all my questions were answered directly, and the agent was polite and provided my loan details without any confusion.
